# Trial referral and recruitment

**Status: blocked — referral and recruitment are separate outcomes without an
approved pathway contract.**

The future schema must contain `id`, unique `referral_id`, `referral_date`,
controlled `referral_type`, `trial_id` or a pseudonymized trial category,
`eligible`, `offered`, `accepted`, `recruitment_date`, `enrolled_date`,
`referral_status`, `decline_reason`, and pathway completeness.  The analysis
must specify denominators separately for referral, offer, acceptance, and
recruitment.

The current `trial_referral` interface has MTB and trial-referral flags but no
offer/acceptance/recruitment dates or eligibility pathway.  A referral flag
cannot be treated as recruitment or enrolment, so this outcome is not run.
